description: Durable cross-session memory about the user. Call when the user asks you to remember, forget, or list what you remember about them — facts and preferences that persist into future sessions.

tool_definition.name: TDA_Memory
tool_definition.description: Stores or recalls DURABLE memory about the user across sessions. Call 'remember' ONLY when the user asks you to remember something or states a lasting preference/fact about themselves (e.g. 'I prefer metric tons', 'I'm a finance analyst', 'always answer concisely'). Call 'forget' to delete a memory. Call 'list_memories' to show what is remembered. Do NOT store this turn's specific question or the answer's data.

content.description: The durable fact/preference to remember, phrased as a short first-person statement (e.g. 'I prefer metric tons for weight'). Required for 'remember'.

kind.description: Optional. 'preference' | 'fact' | 'style'. The component infers this from the content if omitted — only set it to override.

scope.description: 'agent' (default — remembered only by THIS agent) or 'global' (shared across all of the user's agents). Use 'global' only for genuine user-level facts the user wants every agent to know.

query.description: Text to match memories to delete. Required for 'forget'.

intensity_tooltips.medium: Use TDA_Memory when the user explicitly asks to remember/forget something
intensity_tooltips.heavy: Proactively remember durable user preferences and facts as they surface
